issues.description: Constructor signature mismatch for class Farm: the problem statement (and the template Main) expect a no-argument constructor that initializes the internal ArrayList (problem_statement.md: "Initialize the ArrayList in a constructor with no arguments"). The template Main calls new Farm() (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java line 14). The reference solution only defines a constructor with an int parameter (public Farm(int initialCapacity) in solution src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java line 11) and does not provide a public no-arg Farm() constructor. This mismatch will cause compilation errors for the provided template Main and confuses students following the exercise instructions.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a public no-argument constructor to the solution Farm class that initializes the animals list, e.g. public Farm() { this.animals = new ArrayList<>(); }. Keep the existing Farm(int initialCapacity) as an overload if desired. Alternatively (less recommended), update the problem statement and template to require Farm(int initialCapacity) and change template Main accordingly so both artifacts match.
